title: Constitutional Existence Universe — the substrate through which anything that exists is represented
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH, HELD SUBORDINATE UNDER UCKP-LAW-0001. This declaration recognises an implementation that already exists at engine/ceu/. It creates no authority, transfers no ownership, and adds no capability.

constitutional_superior.effect: UCKP-ART-02 requires every governed category of entity to exist exactly once as a canonical object; this substrate is the mechanism by which a category becomes registrable at all. UCKP-ART-18 is why there is one substrate and not one per category: before anything is created its canonical object is located and reused. UCKP-ART-07 is named because relationship INSTANCES are registered here, and every one of them projects the relationship model declared there — this substrate does not own what a relationship IS.

implementation.$note: One registry, one record type. A form is a unit; a classification is a unit; a relationship is a unit; a topology is a unit. All four are registered, identified, lineaged, context-bindable, supersedable and evolvable through the same mechanism — not because each was given those properties, but because there is only one mechanism to give them.

bounded_question: What forms of existence are declared, which units hold each form, and which relationship instances and topology instances hold among them?
$why_the_question_is_bounded: UCOS-CAA-001 existence_resolution declares existence-tracking MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_AUTHORITIES: each authority answers a different bounded question, and holding undisputed authority over one does not compete with another holding undisputed authority over a different one.

This substrate answers a question none of the three prior authorities asks. UCKP-COMPLETENESS-REGISTRY asks whether an object answers all 33 facets. UGA-EXISTENCE-REGISTRY asks whether a version-controlled artifact exists and who owns it. REPOSITORY-INTELLIGENCE asks what can be reused, what is missing and what conflicts.

The second_authority_test declared there is met: the populations do not overlap (154 declared units at bootstrap against UGA's 5,789 tracked artifacts and the completeness registry's 193 objects), and there are no cross-imports in any direction.
owns: existence representation — the registration of a unit of any declared form
entity forms — and the declaration of a form nobody has named yet
existence units — their identity binding, content seal, supersession and resurrection
existence-level relationship INSTANCES, registered as units
existence-level topology INSTANCES, registered as units
does_not_own: the relationship semantic model — what a relationship IS, what an edge is, what makes an edge resolvable. That is UCKP-ART-07 at engine/uckp/graph.py, and CAA-INV-05 permits exactly one owner of it.
the graph resolution model and the relationship ontology rules — UCKP-ART-07.
the object model — UCKO under UCKP-ART-02. CAA-INV-07: every bound instrument that declares object classes names UCKO as the model it projects. This one does.
identity allocation — UCOS-EPIC-001 / REG-AUTO-001. declare_form registers an identifier kind with that authority; it mints nothing of its own.
context resolution — UCXI-000001. bind_context accepts a frame this substrate did not resolve.
lifecycle stage authority — UCKP ART-14 / UAUE-000001.
governance and permission — it represents what exists; it never decides what may happen.
$instance_versus_model: A relationship INSTANCE is a thing that exists, so it is an entity, and it is represented here like every other entity.
A relationship DEFINITION is a semantic contract, and it stays with the canonical relationship model authority.

Separating the two is what prevents duplicate authority, circular dependency and ontology collision, and it is what leaves both free to evolve: a new relationship instance needs no model change, and a model refinement needs no re-registration.

openness.extension_mechanism: ExistenceRegistry.declare_form — a form is admitted as data, by the ordinary registration path, with no code change
openness.$measured: Six forms the substrate had never seen (celestial_body, measurement_unit, currency, language, intelligence_form, and a form named only as a concept nobody has yet named) were admitted with no change to any module, and eleven units were registered under them, including entities for Earth, Mars, Moon, a star, a galaxy, an SI unit, a currency, a language, an intelligence form not yet encountered, and a concept with no name.
openness.$no_category_is_privileged: No function in the substrate branches on a particular form, classification, topology or relationship type. The root form's name is a constructor argument, so even 'form' is not a reserved word.

invariants: Every unit resolves to exactly one form, and a form is itself a unit.
Every unit's identity is minted by UCOS-EPIC-001, never by this substrate.
A relationship instance registered here binds to a relationship class of the UCKP-ART-07 model; this substrate declares no relationship semantics of its own.
A registry binds to exactly one context frame; rebasing produces a new registry rather than mutating the binding.
No count in the substrate is compared against a bound.
